description: Recall where the previous session left off: recent turns, salient anchors, unresolved DiAML arcs, related track crystals, checkpoints, and open queues.

n.description: Number of recent turns to recall (default: 5)

since.description: Time-range floor: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

token_budget.description: Optional cap for compact agent_context.text: UTF-8 byte cap is token_budget × 4; estimated_tokens is a byte-based heuristic, not tokenizer-guaranteed. Zero produces empty context.

track.description: Optional track slug to surface prior crystallized codex memories and select the latest prior session on this track

until.description: Time-range ceiling: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

name: session.continuity
title: Session Continuity
